Definition: Ethanim, the name of a month
BiblicalUsage: Ethanim is the name of a month. In 1 Kings 8:2, the text says "And all the men of Israel assembled themselves unto king Solomon at the feast in the month Ethanim."
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Ethanim matters because God knows His people by name — even the ones Scripture mentions only once.
